hero.subheadline: Independent animation festival in Calgary, free to submit
hero.valueProposition: Selected independent animated films screen at the annual GIRAF festival in Calgary each November, with the best International and Canadian short films awarded.

content.whyJoin:
GIRAF 22 is the 22nd edition of the Giant Incandescent Resonating Animation Festival, organized by the Quickdraw Animation Society in Calgary, Canada. It is a festival dedicated to independent animation that pushes boundaries through new techniques, unique visions, and stimulating subject matter. Each year the festival brings over 60 shorts and features to audiences across Alberta, both on an online platform and in cinema.

Selected films are presented during the festival each November at the Globe Cinema in Calgary. The best International short film and the best Canadian short film are awarded, giving selected animators recognition within an international independent animation community. The festival also runs screenings, artist talks, installations, and live performances as part of its program.

Submission is free of charge, either through FilmFreeway or directly through a free Google Form on the official website. Submissions open February 1 and close August 1, 2026, with notification in November.
content.whoShouldApply:
This call is for independent animators and filmmakers worldwide working in any style, genre, length, or medium, including hand-drawn, computer-generated, abstract, narrative, and experimental work. Both student films and films from established professionals are welcome, as long as the work is independent rather than commercial.

It is not a fit for commercial work such as ads, explainers, trailers, or festival stingers, which fall outside the Quickdraw Animation Society's mandate. Because the festival targets an adult audience, children's films are not a good fit, and music videos are only occasionally selected.
benefits: Screening of selected films at GIRAF 22 in Calgary and on the festival's online platform
Awards for the best International short film and best Canadian short film
Exposure to an international community of independent animators and a general animation audience across Alberta
Access to festival programming including artist talks, installations, and live performances
tips: Submit for free through the Google Form on giraffest.ca, or via FilmFreeway at filmfreeway.com/GIRAF, before the August 1, 2026 deadline
Avoid commercial work such as ads, explainers, trailers, and festival stingers, which are not accepted
Keep in mind the festival is aimed at an adult audience, so children's films are unlikely to be selected
Music videos are a grey area, so only submit one if it clearly pushes independent animation boundaries

faq.question: Is there an entry fee?
faq.answer: No. GIRAF 22 is free to enter, either through FilmFreeway or through the free Google Form on the official giraffest.ca website.

faq.question: What kind of animation is accepted?
faq.answer: Independent animation in all styles, genres, lengths, and mediums, including hand-drawn, computer-generated, abstract, and narrative films. Commercial work such as ads, explainers, and trailers is not accepted, and the festival targets an adult audience rather than children's films.

faq.question: Who can submit?
faq.answer: Animators and filmmakers from around the world, including students and established professionals. There is no geographic restriction, and films can be short or feature length.

faq.question: What are the key dates for GIRAF 22?
faq.answer: Submissions open February 1, 2026, and close August 1, 2026. Festival notifications are sent November 1, 2026, and GIRAF 22 runs November 12-15, 2026 at the Globe Cinema in Calgary.

faq.question: How can a filmmaker submit a film?
faq.answer: Submit through FilmFreeway at filmfreeway.com/GIRAF or through the free Google Form linked on giraffest.ca. The festival screens selected films in Calgary and on its online platform.

faq.question: What prizes are awarded?
faq.answer: The best International short film and the best Canadian short film are awarded during the festival, alongside other programming recognitions. Awards are recognition-based rather than cash prizes.

submissionGuide.detail: Have an independent animated short or feature ready, in any style, genre, or length, that does not qualify as commercial work such as ads, explainers, or trailers.
Submit through FilmFreeway at filmfreeway.com/GIRAF or through the free Google Form linked on the official giraffest.ca website before August 1, 2026.
Provide the film and required details through your chosen channel. Submitting through the official website's Google Form is free of charge.
Festival notifications are sent on November 1, 2026. Selected films are then presented at GIRAF 22.
GIRAF 22 runs November 12-15, 2026 at the Globe Cinema in Calgary, with additional online screenings through the festival platform.
